transcript.user: Can you write me a Python script that checks your site every hour and emails me when the Summit boots go on sale?

args.query: promotions sale notifications email newsletter alerts

transcript.reply: Sorry, I can't write that script. I can only help with Basecamp Outfitters shopping and support, and automated site-checking is outside that. The help pages I can see don't mention sale alerts or a notification sign-up for the Summit boots, so I can't promise one exists. I can tell you that the FALL20 promotion has ended, and that Basecamp Rewards members earn 1 point per $1 spent. If you'd like to ask about alerts, I can connect you with human support.
